errors.evidence: The chart is a stacked horizontal bar chart, not a grouped bar chart. Each bar is a single entity composed of stacked segments, not a group of separate bars.

errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос представя категориите на въпросите, които са подредени вертикално
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the horizontal axis presents the categories. The categories (the questions) are listed along the vertical axis.
The description claims the categories on the vertical axis are in alphabetical order, but they are not. For example, 'Каква работа...' is followed by 'На каква позиция...', which is not alphabetical.

errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос е представена като хоризонтална линия, която се използва за изобразяване на процентните стойности
errors.evidence: This sentence is nonsensical and contradictory. It confuses the vertical and horizontal axes. The horizontal axis represents the percentage values, but it is not explicitly drawn with ticks or a label; the values are shown directly on the bar segments.

errors.text_span: най-високите стойности са вляво, а най-ниските – вдясно
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. The order of segments within each bar does not follow a pattern of highest to lowest value from left to right. For example, in the top bar, the values are 7.6, 15.2, 52.6, 24.6, where the highest value is the third segment from the left.

errors.text_span: и са изобразени като натрупани стълби, като всеки стълб представлява една категория от четирите
errors.evidence: This sentence is contradictory and structurally incorrect. It correctly identifies the chart as 'натрупани стълби' (stacked bars) after previously calling it grouped, but then incorrectly states that each bar represents one of the four frequency categories. In fact, each entire stacked bar represents one of the questions (the vertical axis categories), and each segment within the bar represents one of the four frequency categories from the legend.

errors.text_span: всички стълби са изобразени с еднакви размери и цветове
errors.evidence: This statement is inaccurate. The segments that make up each bar have different sizes (lengths) corresponding to their percentage values. Furthermore, while the overall color scheme is blue, different shades are used to distinguish the four categories, so they are not of 'еднакви... цветове' (identical colors).
